lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Prime Minister Mark Carney says Canada is working to become an "associate member" of the European Union, after largely avoiding that term, The Canadian Press reports.
Prime Minister Mark Carney says it would be a mistake for Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. to fail to honour the commitments it made when it bought Stelco, The Canadian Press reports.
Prime Minister Mark Carney says his government will invest up to $1.6 billion in Canadian AI company Cohere, The Canadian Press reports.
Canada’s unions prepare for nationwide fight over Ottawa’s labour law proposals, The Canadian Press reports.
A 13-year-old girl who was severely injured in the Tumbler Ridge mass shooting is being released from hospital after nearly nine months of uncertain recovery, her father says.

The Trump administration said Wednesday that it is blocking shipments by the Chinese biotech company BGI Group and its affiliates, alleging ties to forced labour in China’s far-west ethnic region of Xinjiang, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
